core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aqilah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Wise, sensible”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aqilah corresponds to the Arabic form عاقلة (Arabic root ع ق ل (ʿ-q-l); عَاقِلَة (ʿāqilah)). Its core sense is wise; sensible. Aqilah is Arabic عَاقِلَة (ʿāqilah) 'Wise, sensible', the feminine active participle (fāʿilah pattern, feminine of عاقل (ʿāqil)) of عَقَلَ (ʿaqala, 'to understand, to be reasonable') from the root ع ق ل (ʿ-q-l). Aqilah is a variant romanization of Aqila.

etymology.morphology: Feminine active participle (fāʿilah pattern, feminine of عاقل) of عَقَلَ, built on the root ع ق ل.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ع ق ل (ʿ-q-l)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عاقلة is an established Arabic lexical item — the feminine of عاقل (ʿāqil) — and Aqilah is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

language_notes.primary: Arabic is the language of the recorded form عاقلة.
language_notes.usage: Other scripts are transliterations of the name into those writing systems; they are not independent origins.

origin.origin_explanation: The name originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming through established multilingual use.

religion.religious_status: Culturally used; not inherently a doctrinal term
religion.religious_explanation: Aqilah is used by Muslims as a personal name, but the word itself is lexical in origin; its Islamic association is cultural rather than scriptural.

quranic_status.note: Aqilah is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name, so no Qur'anic basis is claimed.

islamic_naming_context.context: Muslim naming culture in South Asia and the Persianate world
islamic_naming_context.interpretation: Its lexical sense is a positive quality that families may wish for a child.
islamic_naming_context.important_distinction: Muslim use of the name is not evidence that the word is Qur'anic or religiously prescribed.

urdu.name: عاقلہ
urdu.long_meaning: Aqilah (عاقلہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم عاقلہ، دانا، سمجھدار ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: عاقلة
persian.long_meaning: Aqilah (عاقلة) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عاقل، خردمند، دانا است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: अक़ीला
hindi.long_meaning: Aqilah (अक़ीला) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ बुद्धिमान, विवेकशील है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: عاقله
pashto.long_meaning: Aqilah (عاقله) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې عاقله، پوه ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: عاقلة
arabic.long_meaning: Aqilah (عاقلة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي العاقلة، الحكيمة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: It is built on the root ع ق ل (ʿ-q-l).

faq.a: Documented usage records Aqilah as a girl's name; actual use can vary by community.
